assets.prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Asset type: original logo for SUSHI Clerks Comprehensive Exam Reviewer, a playful medical undergraduate exam study app. Create one polished, compact, memorable kawaii-inspired sushi mascot brand logo with the word SUSHI in expressive rounded chunky custom lettering. A smiling salmon nigiri sushi character wearing a tiny rose-pink stethoscope, simple friendly face, a tiny dark burgundy seaweed accent, no red cross emblem. Warm coral salmon #ED8F93, deep raspberry #9D3656, pale pink #FFE4E6, cream rice #FFF8EF, tiny soft sage accent. Clean flat vector-like shapes, subtle hand-drawn character, crisp silhouette suitable for a mobile header, deliberately limited details. Logo icon above or beside the exact text 'SUSHI' only, high-quality professional brand mark, tightly composed but with safe padding, transparent background. No additional words, no mockup, no gradients, no photographic elements, no watermark.

Use case: ads-marketing. Create a wide 3:1 brand banner for a playful medical undergraduate study app, matching the supplied SUSHI mascot logo. Preserve the recognizable smiling salmon nigiri mascot with burgundy outline, cream rice, coral-pink salmon, and rose stethoscope. New composition on a fully opaque warm ivory-pink #FFF5F1 background with sparse tiny rose stars and soft sage doodle accents. Flat clean illustrated stationery aesthetic, no glow, no dark backdrop. Right third: mascot next to a small neat stack of books and an exam clipboard, oversized friendly shapes; no word SUSHI on the mascot itself. Left two thirds: elegant playful rounded typography with exact text 'SUSHI' large in deep raspberry, underneath 'Clerks Comprehensive' and then 'Exam Reviewer' in smaller very legible deep raspberry type. Exact text only: 'SUSHI Clerks Comprehensive Exam Reviewer'. Comfortable generous empty margins, everything safely within canvas. Fun, warm, polished and useful for adult medical students. No institutional symbols, no red-cross mark, no watermark, no tiny unreadable detail, no glossy 3D effects.
